versions.changelog:
- Updated the skill description to more concisely state its deliverables and usage exclusions.
- Updated the skill and manifest files for version 1.3.18.
- Removed `skill-card.md`.

Version 1.3.17 adds a guided, testable setup for long-document translation projects.

- Added project initialization with full and light workflow options, plus generated templates and a project-specific runbook.
- Added translation-checking tools and fixtures for self-tests, including checks for failure cases and misleading “all clear” reports.
- Expanded guidance on workflow selection, script warnings, quality checks, parallel translation, and common pitfalls.
- Added English and Chinese READMEs and reference guides; removed `skill-card.md`.

- Added comprehensive documentation in SKILL.md detailing the end-to-end workflow for high-quality Chinese translation of long foreign-language academic works.
- Workflow includes parsing, cleaning/slicing, style & glossary setup, parallel batch translation, multi-dimensional QA, and final merging with enhanced HTML reading interface.
- Emphasized strict terminological consistency, source page code retention, footnote handling, and traceable translation uncertainties.
- Documented frequent pitfalls (e.g., overlapping slices, batch translation QA) with tested solutions and checklists.
- Described included scripts for QA, deduplication, merging, and HTML reader building, with configuration guidance for reuse on new projects.
- Provided typical parameters and practical experience based on large-scale real project (800+ page German monograph).
